correctness_preflight: passed: load/store values for every width/candidate; uncontended and 4-thread RMW totals for widths 1/2/4/8; 16-byte CASP and LDXP/STLXP carry and 4-thread totals
notes: Twenty paired samples per candidate comparison; every side is required to sum to at least 200 ms.
A warmup and a calibration pass are discarded before retained samples.
Ordinary candidates use separate same-width atomic storage; packed means distinct words on one 64-byte cache line.
RMW contention uses one shared word; uncontended runs use one word per worker.
Inline ARM candidates are instruction probes, not Rust production memory-safety guarantees.
The 16-byte RMW candidate compares CASPAL with LDXP/STLXP; Rust std exposes no 128-bit Atomic type.
